name: auth-failure
description: The API role's client secret has been rotated, so /api/oauth/token answers 401 every time. A permanently refused credential, as opposed to the one-off 401 that auth-refresh covers. The run must END THE TASK IN ERROR: reporting zero assets and exiting 0 is what an empty tenant does, so without the error an operator sees a green task and an estate that appears to have emptied itself. The refusal is not retried either -- 401 is outside the transient retry set -- which is what the pinned request count carries. No inventory request may follow.  The failure comes from oauth2_token() itself, which raises on any non-2xx rather than handing back an err string -- so this integration already ended the task in error, and the assertion is the builtin's own message. main() keeps a guard for the other shape the same call can produce, a 2xx carrying no token, which oauth2_token does not raise on.
